headline: Skyline Cranes Acquisition: Deal Worth 255 Million Shekels
summary: The acquisition of Skyline Cranes by ILift reaches 255 million shekels for 75% of the Israeli construction crane company.
why: Construction cranes are capital equipment used in building projects, and consolidation in the sector can change competitive dynamics and equipment supply.
